reason: A DeepSeek Harness skill and host-side tool for dispatching tasks to multiple external coding-agent CLIs and returning their results, with optional workspace writes controlled by the target CLI configuration.

summaries.zh: 将任务分派给多个外部编码代理命令行工具，并把执行结果返回到 DeepSeek Harness 对话中。
summaries.en: Dispatches tasks to multiple external coding-agent CLIs and returns their command output to the DeepSeek Harness conversation.

capabilities: dispatches task text to configured external agent CLIs
executes external CLI commands in headless mode
returns delegated command output to the conversation
may permit delegated agents to write workspace files when configured
